title: 第05章 蛮人入府第06章 武道境界划分
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 端坐在主位旁、一身缟素、面容枯槁的老太君，在看到孙儿的那一刻，浑浊的眼中更是涌出泪水。
她强撑了数日的坚强，在见到这唯一的血脉时，几乎是要崩溃。
她颤巍巍地伸出手：“逸儿……你……你不好好躺着，来这里做什么……快回去歇着……”
方云逸在福伯的搀扶下，一步步挪到祖母面前。他看着眼前老人仿佛彻底垮掉的精神气，心中酸楚难当。
他缓缓跪了下去，尽管这个动作几乎耗尽了他全部的力气。
“祖母……”他的声音微弱，却带着一抹坚定，“孙儿是如今方家唯一男儿……阿爷、大伯、二伯、兄长……为朝捐躯，孙儿……理当披麻戴孝，送他们最后一程。”
他接过下人递来的麻衣孝帽，让福伯郑重地帮他穿戴在身上。
那宽大的麻衣更显得他身形瘦小，仿佛随时会被压垮，但他挺直了瘦弱的脊梁，尽管摇摇欲坠，却未曾倒下。
他走到香案前，拿起三炷香，在烛火上点燃，然后，在所有人惊愕目光中，缓缓地、却无比郑重地跪了下去，将香举过头顶，拜了三拜。
“孙儿方云逸，来送阿爷、大伯、二伯、云霆哥……”
他的声音不大，却清晰地回荡在寂静的灵堂里，“方家……还有人尚在。请长辈们……安息。”
这话一出，老太君眼泪再也抑制不住，夺眶而出。
她一把将方云逸瘦弱的身体搂在怀里，泣不成声：“我的逸儿……我苦命的逸儿啊……方家……就只剩下你了……”
周围的仆从、老兵也再也忍不住，放声痛哭起来。这哭声里，有对方家满门忠烈的哀悼，有对未来的迷茫，也有对这仅存血脉的怜惜和一丝……微弱的希望。
方云逸任由祖母抱着，他能感受到老人身体的颤抖和那份深沉的绝望。
他抬起手，轻轻拍着祖母的后背，用尽可能平稳的语气，“祖母，您放心！逸儿还在，方家不会因此而倒下。”
他的话，在旁人听来，只是一个七岁病童天真安慰，只有方云逸自己知道，这是承诺，是来自一个异世灵魂占据了原主身份的誓言。
就在这时，灵堂外传来一阵轻微的骚动。
一名府内的老卒快步走进来，在老太君耳边低语了几句，面色凝重。
老太君抬手轻拭几下眼角，镇定下来！
“请他们进来。”
片刻过后，只见三名穿着普通大乾百姓服装、戴着宽大斗笠的男子走进灵堂。
他们身形魁梧、气息沉稳，步伐矫健，举止间带着一股沙场特有的彪悍气息。
为首一人摘下斗笠，露出一张与中原人迥异的面孔——高颧骨，深眼窝，鼻梁高挺，皮肤因常年严寒酷晒而显得有些粗糙，正是标准的蛮族面貌！
就见他径直走到灵前，取下斗笠，恭恭敬敬地上了三炷香，然后三鞠躬。
当他转过身时，灵堂内顿时响起一片倒吸冷气的声音。“蛮人！”
“他们怎么敢来这里！”
有老兵怒目而视，想要起身，却被身旁的人按住。如今方府势微，这个时候不能再节外生枝。
那蛮人首领对周围敌意目光恍若未觉，目光扫过众人，最后落在主位上的老太君和披麻戴孝的方云逸身上。
他缓步上前，在距离老太君五步远的地方停下，右手抚胸，行了一个蛮族的礼节，声音低沉而清晰。
content_en:
Sitting next to the main seat, the old lady dressed in plain clothes and with a withered face, tears welled up in her muddy eyes when she saw her grandson.
She had held on for several days, but when she saw this only bloodline, she almost collapsed.
She stretched out her hand tremblingly: "Yi'er... you... why don't you lie down well... go back and rest..."
With Uncle Fu's support, Fang Yunyi moved step by step to her grandmother. He looked at the old man in front of him who seemed to have completely collapsed, and felt extremely sad in his heart.
He slowly knelt down, although this movement almost exhausted all his strength.
"Grandma..." His voice was weak, but with a touch of determination, "My grandson is the only son of the Fang family now... My grandfather, uncle, second uncle, and elder brother... sacrificed their lives for the government, and my grandson... should wear sackcloth and show mourning to see them off on their last journey."
He took the linen filial piety hat handed to him by his servant and asked Uncle Fu to help him put it on solemnly.
The large linen clothes made his figure even smaller, as if he would be crushed at any time, but he straightened his thin spine, and although he was teetering, he never fell.
He walked to the incense table, picked up three sticks of incense, lit it on the candle, and then, under everyone's astonished eyes, slowly but solemnly knelt down, raised the incense above his head, and bowed three times.
"My grandson Fang Yunyi is here to see off my grandfather, uncle, second uncle, and brother Yunting..."
His voice was not loud, but it echoed clearly in the silent mourning hall, "There are still people in the Fang family who are still alive. Elders, please rest in peace."
As soon as these words came out, the old lady could no longer hold back her tears and burst into tears.
She hugged Fang Yunyi's thin body in her arms and burst into tears: "My Yi'er... my miserable Yi'er... the Fang family... you are the only one left..."
The servants and veterans around him couldn't bear it anymore and burst into tears. In this cry, there is the mourning of the other party's loyal family, confusion about the future, pity for the only remaining bloodline and a trace of... weak hope.
Fang Yunyi let his grandmother hold him. He could feel the trembling of the old man's body and the deep despair.
He raised his hand, patted his grandmother's back gently, and said in as calm a tone as possible, "Grandma, don't worry! Yi'er is still here, and the Fang family will not fall because of this."
To others, his words sounded like the innocent comfort of a seven-year-old sick child. Only Fang Yunyi knew that they were a promise, an oath from a soul from another world who had taken over the identity of the original owner.
At this moment, there was a slight commotion outside the mourning hall.
An old soldier from the mansion walked in quickly and whispered a few words into the old lady's ear with a solemn expression.
The old lady raised her hand and wiped the corners of her eyes a few times to calm down!
"Invite them in."
After a while, three men wearing ordinary civilian clothes and large bamboo hats were seen walking into the mourning hall.
They are tall and tall, with a calm aura, strong steps, and a strong aura unique to the battlefield in their demeanor.
The leader took off his bamboo hat, revealing a face that was very different from that of the Central Plains people - high cheekbones, deep eye sockets, a straight bridge of the nose, and the skin looked a little rough due to the severe cold and sun all year round. It was a standard barbarian appearance!
I saw him walking straight to the soul, taking off his bamboo hat, respectfully placing three sticks of incense, and then bowing three times.
When he turned around, there was a sudden gasp of air in the mourning hall. "Barbarian!"
"How dare they come here!"
Some veterans glared angrily and tried to get up, but were held down by the people next to them. Now that Fang Mansion is in a weak position, there can be no extraneous matters at this time.
The barbarian leader seemed unaware of the hostility around him. His eyes swept across the crowd, and finally landed on the old lady on the throne and Fang Yunyi, who was wearing sackcloth and wearing filial piety.
He stepped forward slowly and stopped five steps away from the old lady. He put his right hand on his chest and performed a barbarian etiquette. His voice was low and clear.
